claims.text: Arrears fell from 4.1 percent of GDP at end-2023 to 2.6 percent of GDP at end-2025.

claims.approved_wording: Energy-sector arrears fell from 4.1 percent of GDP at end-2023 to 2.6 percent of GDP at end-2025.

claims.approved_wording: Collection rates rose from 78 percent in 2023 to 86 percent in 2025.

claims.text: The cash waterfall mechanism was introduced in March 2024.

claims.text: The cash waterfall drove the reduction in arrears.
claims.author: deepseek
claims.approved_wording: The cash waterfall appears to have contributed to the reduction in arrears, alongside higher collections and the 2025 arrears clearance.

evidence.excerpt: The decline in arrears coincided with the introduction of the cash waterfall and with higher collections. The available data do not allow the contribution of each factor to be separated.
